description.la: De magistro. Textus Latinus secundum editionem Maurinorum.
description.en-US: On the Teacher (389), by St. Augustine of Hippo. Latin text of the Maurist edition; no public-domain English translation has been imported yet.
description.pt-BR: O mestre (389), de Santo Agostinho de Hipona. Texto latino da edição dos Maurinos.

sources.edition: Maurist text (Benedictines of Saint-Maur, 1679-1700) as printed in Migne, Patrologia Latina, on augustinus.it (Corpus Augustinianum Gissense / NBA Latin pages)
sources.description: Latin pages maestro of augustinus.it, one page per book, long pages split at chapter boundaries. The Italian NBA headings, summaries and biblical-reference notes are dropped; section numbers and italicised quotations are kept. Raw mirror in research/sourcing/augustine-latin/raw.
sources.tierEvidence: Text of a 4th-5th-century work in the Maurist edition (1679-1700, Migne 1841-49), long public domain.

sources.edition: F. E. Tourscher, The Philosophy of Teaching: a study in the symbolism of language, a translation of Saint Augustine's De Magistro (Villanova College, Pennsylvania, 1924)
sources.description: OCR of the archive.org scan. Running heads removed and speaker labels normalised; the translator's footnotes remain run into the text; the introduction and appendix are not included.
